Flux-integrated CC-inclusive 
u_\mu cross-section ratios (C/CH, Fe/CH, Pb/CH) vs Bjorken x and vs neutrino energy E_
u (2-20 GeV, <E_
u>=8 GeV), MINERvA nuclear-target passive planes vs the CH scintillator tracker in the NuMI beam.
provenance: MINERvA:2014rdw — dimensionless cross-section-ratio measurement (not an absolute cross section): sigma^A/sigma^CH for A=C,Fe,Pb, each vs x_Bjorken and vs E_nu. Values, stat, and sys errors taken from the arXiv ancillary files anc/supp-tab3_xsec-ratio-x.csv and anc/supp-tab4_xsec-ratio-E.csv (identical to PRL-supplement-NukeCC.tex Tables I/II, 'Data' column = measured ratio). Total error = sqrt(stat^2+sys^2). Six independent 1d distributions (one per target x one per kinematic variable) rather than a 2d/3d grouping, since the target-material split is categorical, not a continuous slicing variable, and each is a single-differential ratio in one variable at a time.
cov_note: 42x42 block-diagonal covariance (6 bins x per-x distribution, 8 bins x per-E distribution), row/col order = distributions concatenated in the order listed above (x_C, x_Fe, x_Pb, E_C, E_Fe, E_Pb), each block's bins in file order. Built as corr_ij * err_i * err_j from the per-target bin-to-bin correlation matrices in anc/supp-tabs7-9_xsec-ratio-correlations-x.csv and anc/supp-tabs10-12_xsec-ratio-correlations-E.csv (err = total = sqrt(stat^2+sys^2)); no cross-target or cross-variable correlations are given in the release, so off-diagonal blocks are zero.
